name: RENDERAUDIT-a-portals-answer-anew
old: const { open: k, done } = portalOpenAt(age, p.when, opened);
new: const { open: k, done } = portalOpenAt(age, p.when);
why: Belt and braces: V8 inlines portalOpenAt into the tick and replaces its one default record by scalars, so dropping the scratch adds nothing the measure sees. The scratch keeps the tick allocation-free where an engine does not inline it; the five return records it replaced were 72 bytes a call.
